why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to Sea Mist, professionally managed by Stay on 30a where laid-back luxury meets the best of 30A living! This beautiful four-bedroom home comfortably sleeps up to ten guests and is perfectly located in the heart of Prominence, one of 30A’s most sought-after communities. From the moment you arrive, Sea Mist invites you to slow down, spread out, and settle into vacation mode. Inside, the home offers spacious, light-filled living areas designed for gathering, relaxing, and making memories together. Whether you’re sharing meals, planning your next beach day, or winding down after sunset, there’s room for everyone to feel right at home. One of the bedrooms features a bunk room, making this space especially ideal for families, kids, and group trips. Step outside onto the front porch and let the sound of the Gulf set the tone for your stay. When you’re ready to explore, you’re just steps away from the community pool and only a short walk to The Big Chill, where you’ll find restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and frequent events that bring Prominence to life day and night. Beach days are effortless here. Enjoy a quick golf cart ride to nearby beach access and spend your time soaking up the sun, swimming in emerald waters, or strolling along the iconic sugar-white sand. Want to explore more of 30A? Cruise over to Seaside by golf cart or bike and experience some of the area’s best dining, boutiques, and coastal charm. To make your stay even better, Sea Mist includes a six-seat golf cart and bikes, giving you everything you need to enjoy the scenic beauty and relaxed pace of 30A. Whether you’re here for a family getaway, a friends’ retreat, or a longer coastal escape, Sea Mist delivers comfort, convenience, and that unforgettable beach-town vibe. This isn’t just a place to stay, it’s your home base for experiencing 30A at its best.

PROMINENCE AMENITIES Prominence on 30A is centrally located and has a variety of on-site and close by amenities that make this community one of the most highly sought-after vacation destinations in 30A. This community features incredible amenities such as: 2 community pools, and a beautiful cabana area for grilling. THE BIG CHILL (FORMERLY "THE HUB") The community’s town center, called “The Big Chill,” includes restaurants, shops, and an amphitheater. The amphitheater includes a covered event pavilion and is a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. This location is perfect for family outings! Be sure to catch the farmer's market here on Thursdays! HOTSPOTS NEARBY The location of Prominence is perfectly placed right in the middle of popular spots like Seaside and Seagrove Beach to the west and Alys Beach, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach to the east. Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture. Seaside also has their own Framer's market! NEARBY BEACH ACCESS -Deer Lake State Park (0.6 miles west of Prominence) is the nearest beach access. This park has great amenities including: restrooms, parking for golf carts/bikes/cars, and a beautiful walk along a boardwalk that winds through the natural dunes leading to the beach. The State Park charges a “Day Use Fee” of $3/car or $2/bikes or pedestrians for access and parking. Alcohol is not allowed as it is a State Park. It is a bit of a longer walk from parking area to the beach, but it’s a beautiful scenic walk on the long boardwalk with white sand dunes. The State Park Beach is less crowded than any public beach access points. -Walton Dunes Beach Access (1.5 miles West of Prominence) has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites! -Gulf Lakes Estates is a South Walton County beach access (1 mile east of Prominence). Small access that can be easily missed. Parking not available but easy bike ride to the beach. -Santa Clara is a public beach access located at Bramble Grove Place (about 3.5 miles). This access provides a lifeguard, parking and bathrooms as well as ADA access to the beach. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including patio spaces. *No parties or events.  *Complimentary golf cart can only be operated by guests over 25 years of age who provide verification. Rental agreement requires a valid drivers license and proof of existing auto insurance coverage. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *This home must remain pet free. IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie".
